finalText:
Implementation complete. All 7 OpenSpec tasks are checked off, `openspec validate --strict` passes, `TASK.md` and the existing benchmark test (`tests/orders.test.ts`) are untouched, and the full suite is green.

What was built

`POST /orders/:id/apply-coupon` now validates the coupon (exists, `ACTIVE`, within `validFrom`/`validUntil` via the injected clock, order amount ≥ `minAmountCents`), computes the discount (`FIXED` subtracts cents; `PERCENT` takes a floored percentage capped by `maxDiscountCents` and the order amount), and persists the code/discount/final amount plus a redemption row in one transaction.

| Area | File |
| --- | --- |
| Route | [orders.ts](/work/src/routes/orders.ts:10) |
| Business rules | [orderService.ts](/work/src/services/orderService.ts:44) |
| Persistence | [orderRepository.ts](/work/src/repositories/orderRepository.ts:62), [couponRepository.ts](/work/src/repositories/couponRepository.ts:71), [db.ts](/work/src/db.ts:60) |
| Wiring | [app.ts](/work/src/app.ts:32) |
| New tests (11) | [apply-coupon.test.ts](/work/tests/apply-coupon.test.ts:1) |

OpenSpec artifacts live in [openspec/changes/order-apply-coupon](/work/openspec/changes/order-apply-coupon/proposal.md) (proposal, spec, design, tasks) and all four are `done`.

Assumptions I locked in and documented in the spec/design, since the task left them open:

- All coupon failures return HTTP 400 (including an unknown coupon), matching the acceptance criterion "无效的优惠券返回 HTTP 400"; an unknown *order* keeps the existing 404 `ORDER_NOT_FOUND`.
- `PERCENT` rounds down (`floor`) and is capped by `maxDiscountCents`, then by the order amount; `FIXED` is capped at the order amount so the final amount never goes negative.
- `usage_limit` enforcement and re-applying/replacing a coupon were treated as out of scope.

Verification: `npm run build` clean and `npm test` → 2 files, 16 tests passed (5 pre-existing + 11 new). I stopped before archiving since you asked to stop at implementation; archiving remains available via the `openspec-archive-change` workflow if you want it.
